item.title: Rendering PlantUML Diagrams in Hugo
item.description: This blog is generated using Hugo 1. I have always wished that it had a way to render PlantUML diagrams 2. I am not alone in wishing for this - this is a feature that people have requested for over 5 years for now 3. But because of the peculiarities of Hugo’s opinionated security posture 4 and how PlantUML requires starting a Java process 5, it has always been rejected 6. People have found various workarounds:
